# Golden descriptor-byte fixtures for the generated schedule catalogs.
#
# Owned by specs/parameter-struct-consolidation.md (step 1).
# Steps 2 through 4 of that plan produced an EMPTY diff here.
# Step 5d broke everything above the commit-phase profile on purpose:
#   - the terminal descriptor is now role-atomic (geometry, A role, fold),
#   - protocol_epoch 1 -> 2, schedule-row domain v2 -> v3,
#   - the FoldSchedule descriptor tag 1 -> 2.
# Old proof bytes no longer verify. The commit-phase profile bytes and the
# catalog sort key did NOT move; that subset has its own frozen fixture in
# schedule_frozen_profile_bytes.txt, which must be blessed separately.
#
# Regenerate (only after reading the diff):
#   AKITA_BLESS_SCHEDULE_FIXTURES=1 cargo test -p akita-config \
#     --features all-schedules --test schedule_descriptor_fixtures
#
# Format: <family> [<entry>] <level>  len=<bytes> fnv1a=<hex>
# Digest is FNV-1a 64 over the canonical descriptor bytes.
